0.0.1.summary: Refined account profile and popover menu
changes: Accept the Host-owned Agent user prop for display-only profiles without an auth gate or adapter; explicit null displays a default avatar and localized signed-out profile.
Show a compact themed avatar, userName and userId with a separate upward-opening account popover.
Use the shared Popover for dismissal and focus handling, and retain optional auth.session compatibility when no Host user prop is supplied.
Declare the generated project's icon dependency; preview profiles remain outside the official plugin.
Optional Host-owned authentication with existing Application Gate and Plugin Services.
Support avatar-only narrow header Slots and show a signed-out default when no Host auth session is available.
